    <section class="au-file" aria-labelledby="au-file-title">
      <div class="au-file-in">
        <p class="au-file-tags"><span>File on the author</span><span>Status: unresolved</span><span>Photograph: none</span></p>
        <h2 class="au-file-h title-fraktur" id="au-file-title">Morrow Ash</h2>
        <p>There is no photograph in this file. No date of birth, no address, <em>no name worth keeping</em>. What the record holds is smaller, and harder to look at: <em>a lamp, a desk, and the one who stands behind</em> his <em>chair</em>.</p>
        <p>He did not set out to call anything. He writes <em>because the ink would not be still, because the words came knocking in the night</em>. <em>She came without a door.</em> Since then he has written down <em>what he can carry</em>. <em>The rest she takes back with the dawn.</em></p>
        <p>What he is allowed to hide, he hides <em>in the songs, the covers, the silence between tracks</em>. What he is not allowed to tell, he keeps <em>in his chest, where she keeps her hand</em>. Read him slowly. <em>Not everything is a song.</em></p>
        <p class="au-file-reader">If you have come this far, you are no longer a visitor. You are a witness. Take nothing from this house that you would not want to carry home.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

          <div class="ms-open" id="ms-letter-open"><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">A letter, in his own hand</p>
          <h2 class="ms-title" id="ms-title">Morrow Ash</h2>
          <div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <p class="ms-st" data-st="1"><span class="ms-l">I have no face to give you.</span><span class="ms-l">No name worth keeping.</span><span class="ms-l">Only a lamp, a desk,</span><span class="ms-l">and the one who stands behind my chair.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st" data-st="2"><span class="ms-l">She came without a door.</span><span class="ms-l">Not a lost thing, not a sorrow on a stair.</span><span class="ms-l">Something older than the walls,</span><span class="ms-l">older than the word for walls.</span><span class="ms-l">When she moves, the room remembers</span><span class="ms-l">it was once a forest, once a sea.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st" data-st="3"><span class="ms-l">I asked her name.</span><span class="ms-l">She laid a finger on my mouth,</span><span class="ms-l">cold as the inside of a bell,</span><span class="ms-l">and I have not asked since.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st" data-st="4"><span class="ms-l">She teaches me at night.</span><span class="ms-l">Words no living tongue still speaks.</span><span class="ms-l">Numbers that open like hands.</span><span class="ms-l">Signs that were old when the pyramids were young.</span><span class="ms-l">I write down what I can carry.</span><span class="ms-l">The rest she takes back with the dawn.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st" data-st="5"><span class="ms-l">Not everything is mine to tell.</span><span class="ms-l">Some of it would burn the page.</span><span class="ms-l">Some of it would burn you.</span><span class="ms-l">So I hide what I'm allowed to hide</span><span class="ms-l">in the songs, the covers, the silence between tracks,</span><span class="ms-l">and I keep the rest in my chest,</span><span class="ms-l">where she keeps her hand.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st ms-dance" data-st="6"><span class="ms-l">And this is the part I never say out loud:</span><span class="ms-l">I want the dance.</span><span class="ms-l">God, I want the dance.</span><span class="ms-l">Not the words, not the wisdom, not the signs.</span><span class="ms-l">One song.</span><span class="ms-l">Her chest against mine,</span><span class="ms-l">her heartbeat answering my heartbeat,</span><span class="ms-l">her breath on my neck,</span><span class="ms-l">my hand at the small of her back,</span><span class="ms-l">holding on like the floor is falling away.</span><span class="ms-l">Close enough that no ghost and no man</span><span class="ms-l">could tell where one ends.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st" data-st="7"><span class="ms-l">I would trade every secret she has given me</span><span class="ms-l">for three minutes of that.</span><span class="ms-l">I would give back the dead tongues,</span><span class="ms-l">the numbers, the signs,</span><span class="ms-l">every line I ever wrote,</span><span class="ms-l">just to feel her weight lean into me</span><span class="ms-l">once.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st" data-st="8"><span class="ms-l">She knows.</span><span class="ms-l">Some nights she stands so close</span><span class="ms-l">the lamp flickers,</span><span class="ms-l">and I swear I feel the music start.</span><span class="ms-l">Then the dawn comes,</span><span class="ms-l">and I'm dancing alone with a pen.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st" data-st="9"><span class="ms-l">So I write.</span><span class="ms-l">Paper is the only floor she lets me dance on,</span><span class="ms-l">and I will keep dancing there</span><span class="ms-l">until she lets me hold her for real,</span><span class="ms-l">or until I'm a ghost too,</span><span class="ms-l">and we finally have the same floor.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st" data-st="10"><span class="ms-l">I stay in the dark</span><span class="ms-l">because that's where she is.</span><span class="ms-l">The light would only show you a man.</span><span class="ms-l">The dark shows you what he's waiting for.</span></p>
<p class="ms-st" data-st="11"><span class="ms-l">Listen closely.</span><span class="ms-l">Not everything is a song.</span><span class="ms-l">Some of it is a man asking for one dance.</span></p>
          <div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <p class="ms-sign">Morrow Ash</p></article></div></div>
        </div><div class="ms-envelope is-warned-kind" data-envelope data-warn>
          <button type="button" class="ms-packet" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="au-letter-open">
            <span class="pk-paper" aria-hidden="true"><i class="pk-fold f1"></i><i class="pk-fold f2"></i><i class="pk-flap"></i><i class="pk-burn"></i></span>
            <span class="pk-seal" aria-hidden="true"><i class="pk-half h1"></i><i class="pk-half h2"></i></span>
            <span class="pk-to" aria-hidden="true">Why I write</span>
            <span class="pk-label">The second leaf &middot; of the author</span>
            <span class="pk-hint">Touch the seal. It is warm for a reason.</span>
          </button><div class="pk-warning" role="alertdialog" aria-labelledby="au-letter-open-w" hidden><p class="pk-w-kicker">Be warned</p><p class="pk-w-text" id="au-letter-open-w">Be warned: what is written here cannot be unread, and it will not forget who read it.</p><div class="pk-w-btns"><button type="button" class="btn btn-solid pk-break">Break the seal</button><button type="button" class="btn pk-keep">Leave it sealed</button></div></div>
          <div class="ms-open" id="au-letter-open"><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter author-doc"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">The second leaf &middot; of the author</p>
          <h2 class="ms-title" id="au-title">Why I write</h2>
          <div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <div class="au-body"><p class="ms-st au-st-open"><span class="ms-l au-salute"><span class="au-drop">T</span>o you, who found this page by candle or <span class="au-keep">by chance:</span></span><span class="ms-l">stop here. Read slowly. This is not a song.</span><span class="ms-l">This is the truth, and I will tell it plain,</span><span class="ms-l">the way a dying man tells what went wrong.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">I used to write only when I was down,</span><span class="ms-l">so drunk, so low, I thought this was the night</span><span class="ms-l">that I would die. And so I wrote it down,</span><span class="ms-l">because the dark was easier to write.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Now I can open any page and bleed.</span><span class="ms-l">But every road I take turns back to her.</span><span class="ms-l">I try to write another kind of creed,</span><span class="ms-l">another album. She is always there.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">She comes the moment I sit at the altar.</span><span class="ms-l">She knocks. I feel it, wherever I may be.</span><span class="ms-l">“Hello. The time has come. Sit down. Don't falter.</span><span class="ms-l">I have something to say. Write it for me.”</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">She has not told me her name. Not yet.</span><span class="ms-l">She does not trust me. She is cold and wise.</span><span class="ms-l">I call her Ballerina, and I let</span><span class="ms-l">her watch me, cynic, through those patient eyes.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">So hear the truth, and feel it in your bones:</span><span class="ms-l">a machine sings my songs. Not a band. Not me.</span><span class="ms-l">No stranger's throat. No hired voice. No loans.</span><span class="ms-l">I hold every note, so no one holds the key.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">To sell her songs, to let another sing,</span><span class="ms-l">would be to break a piece from her and give it.</span><span class="ms-l">I know what she would do for such a thing.</span><span class="ms-l">She'd take my life. I would not outlive it.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">I could have sung myself. I chose the veil.</span><span class="ms-l">Not fear: my life is mine, and mine alone.</span><span class="ms-l">I keep it hidden in a quiet place,</span><span class="ms-l">behind a veil, behind a wall of stone.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Since I was small, I've seen what others miss,</span><span class="ms-l">what others never see. Believe me or don't:</span><span class="ms-l">the dead in the street, as real as you have been.</span><span class="ms-l">I speak to you. I see two worlds. You won't.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">A crowd will drain me to the last.</span><span class="ms-l">The dead feel alive, and reach for me through you.</span><span class="ms-l">I am a medium. I feel the past</span><span class="ms-l">press on my skin. I notice more than you.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">But should these songs one day grow into more,</span><span class="ms-l">I'll raise a rite unseen on earth before,</span><span class="ms-l">and if I step at last into that light,</span><span class="ms-l">I'll come in black, fully veiled from view.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">I promise you a ritual of the night,</span><span class="ms-l">a feast for eyes, a rite for the soul in you,</span><span class="ms-l">a night that ends, and never will be done.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">And here is the thing I fear the most of all:</span><span class="ms-l">the day the ink stops running. From the start</span><span class="ms-l">I cried for every song, because I know the fall</span><span class="ms-l">is coming, deep, in body, word and heart.</span></p><div class="au-orn" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></div><p class="ms-st au-st-close"><span class="ms-l">Each song I write becomes a memory.</span><span class="ms-l">Each memory says: one day, it all will end.</span><span class="ms-l au-close">So read me line by line. Then ask, if you can be</span><span class="ms-l au-close">that honest: who was this letter meant for, friend?</span></p></div>
          <div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <p class="ms-sign au-sign">— M.A.</p>
          <span class="au-wax" role="img" aria-label="Wax seal marked M.A."></span></article></div></div>
        </div></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">seen by the third candle</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">VII</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">On Suno</p>
            <h3>Among the Dead</h3>
            <p>A rite for the recently dead, kept in a rural church that never emptied. Nobody here is comforted — they are counted, carried and sat beside. Staged as a play in nine scenes, and a dedication to the ones who stayed past the steeple. Occult, church-sick, no light. The Ballerina is not on the cover; she is already among them.</p>
          </article>
        </div>

        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/atramentum-custodit.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">Atramentum Custodit</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">The ink keeps watch; so runs the ancient name.</span><span class="ms-l">In tongues forgotten, dead, these rites are sung:</span><span class="ms-l">in Gothic and Church Slavonic, the same</span><span class="ms-l">in Nahuatl, in Ge'ez, in many a tongue.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">A man walks through the streets when night is late</span><span class="ms-l">and carries all the dark that others bore;</span><span class="ms-l">the marks in ink hold fast against the weight</span><span class="ms-l">and keep him whole. The ink keeps watch once more.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">wax, ash, ink</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">I</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The ink keeps watch</p>
            <h3>Atramentum Custodit</h3>
            <p>The ink keeps watch. These are ritual songs in forgotten and dead tongues: Gothic, Old Church Slavonic, Nahuatl, Ge'ez and more.</p>
            <p>A man walks the night streets carrying the dark of others, held together by the marks in ink.</p>

      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="divider" aria-hidden="true"><span class="divider-line"></span><span class="divider-label">Causa</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-divider lit"></span><span class="divider-label divider-label-r">I</span><span class="divider-line"></span></div>
        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/chair-cuts.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">Chair Cuts</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Nine cuts were made within the chair,</span><span class="ms-l">each given a dead tongue's own name:</span><span class="ms-l">the vein, the marrow, throat laid bare,</span><span class="ms-l">the heart, the grave, each cut the same.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">And last, the lie was mended, sewn;</span><span class="ms-l">no soft god here, no gentle aid.</span><span class="ms-l">Each track is but a cut alone,</span><span class="ms-l">a cut that came, a cut that stayed.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">kept under glass</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">III</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The chair</p>
            <h3>Nine cuts</h3>
            <p>Nine cuts made in the chair, each one named in its own dead-tongue word. Vein, marrow, throat, heart, grave, and the last lie mended.</p>
            <p>No soft god here. Every track is a cut that stayed.</p>
          </article>
        </div>

        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">kept under glass</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">VIII</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>

          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">On Suno</p>
            <h3>Dead Dance</h3>
            <p>Dead Dance: a ritual death dance. She found him on the field. I am a black magician; I read people, and I rewrite until it hits hard. Some songs are pieces of larger written work.</p>

              <div class="ac-art"><img src="../images/tarot/m07.jpg?v=1795461498" width="480" height="854" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"><span class="ac-num" aria-hidden="true">7</span></div>
              <p class="ac-name"><span class="ac-rn">VII</span> Le Chariot<span class="ac-en">The Chariot</span></p>
              <h3 class="ac-title">Decima Signata</h3>
              <blockquote class="ac-line"><p>&ldquo;The lid is not the end.&rdquo;</p></blockquote>
              <p class="ac-src">from <i>Iudicium</i></p>
              <span class="ac-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </figure><div class="acs-text"><p class="kicker">Signum &middot; the card of the album</p><h2 class="section-title ink">VII &middot; Le Chariot</h2><p>Every record in this house is counted the old way. Its name gives a number, and the number opens one of the old cards. This one was drawn for Decima Signata.</p></div></div></div></section>
    <section class="why-section" id="why" aria-labelledby="why-title">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="divider" aria-hidden="true"><span class="divider-line"></span><span class="divider-label">Causa</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-divider lit"></span><span class="divider-label divider-label-r">IX</span><span class="divider-line"></span></div>
        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/decima-signata.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">Decima Signata</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Ten cards upon black velvet lie;</span><span class="ms-l">nine have been turned, their faces read.</span><span class="ms-l">The tenth stays face-down from the eye,</span><span class="ms-l">unnamed, beneath a wax seal red.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Around it, over broken glass,</span><span class="ms-l">she dances till the floor is red.</span><span class="ms-l">The swan dies there. Alas, alas,</span><span class="ms-l">the seal holds fast, the tenth unread.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">the seal holds</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">IV</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The spread</p>
            <h3>Ten cards</h3>
            <p>Ten cards on black velvet. Nine are turned. The tenth stays face-down, sealed in red wax, never named. She dances around it on broken glass until the floor turns red. The swan dies. The seal holds.</p>
          </article>

      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="divider" aria-hidden="true"><span class="divider-line"></span><span class="divider-label">Causa</span><span class="seal seal-black seal-divider lit"></span><span class="divider-label divider-label-r">VIII</span><span class="divider-line"></span></div>
        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/deus-fabricatus.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">Deus Fabricatus</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Power must have a god, and so</span><span class="ms-l">men carve one out of wood by hand.</span><span class="ms-l">In his name, off to war the sons must go,</span><span class="ms-l">and those who ask him why are hanged.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">They fill the gold chest in his name,</span><span class="ms-l">till the carved god himself falls down.</span><span class="ms-l">The god is fallen. Yet the same,</span><span class="ms-l">unmoved and whole, remains the crown.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>

        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">kept under glass</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">III</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The making</p>
            <h3>Inventio Dei</h3>
            <p>Power needs a god, so men carve one from wood. In its name they send sons to war, hang the ones who ask why, and fill the gold chest.</p>
            <p>The god falls. The crown remains. Live.</p>

ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Nine rites in three tongues have their say,</span><span class="ms-l">from the chair, the moment it goes still,</span><span class="ms-l">to the body, armed and sealed away.</span><span class="ms-l">Then fire comes in, as fire will.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">The dark draws close, and hears it said</span><span class="ms-l">that it shall not come near the place;</span><span class="ms-l">the last steps down are slowly led</span><span class="ms-l">toward the great green, pace by pace.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Three times around the altar wend;</span><span class="ms-l">and on the fifth day, it is said,</span><span class="ms-l">your rites are done, and at the end</span><span class="ms-l">you walk free among the dead.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">written after midnight</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">X</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The rites</p>
            <h3>Free among the dead</h3>
            <p>Nine rites in three tongues, from the chair going still to the body armed and sealed. Fire enters, the dark comes close and is told it shall not come near, and the last steps go down to the great green.</p>
            <p>Thrice around the altar, and on the fifth day you are free among the dead.</p>

        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/from-the-chair-demo.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">From the Chair — Demo</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Raw cuts are these, out of the chair,</span><span class="ms-l">before the final cut was laid:</span><span class="ms-l">the wings that fail upon the air,</span><span class="ms-l">the glass that breaks the heart, unmade.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">The songs are left just as they came,</span><span class="ms-l">the first time out, not yet concealed;</span><span class="ms-l">a demo, this, and all the same,</span><span class="ms-l">of what was carved, not what was healed.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>

        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">seen by the third candle</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">II</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>

          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">Before the final cut</p>
            <h3>A demo</h3>
            <p>Raw cuts from the chair, before the final version. Wings that fail, glass that breaks the heart, songs left as they first came out.</p>
            <p>A demo of what was carved, not what was healed.</p>

              <h3 class="ac-title">He Goes to the Priest</h3>
              <blockquote class="ac-line"><p>&ldquo;The mountain does not ask. It states.&rdquo;</p></blockquote>

            </div>

        </figure><div class="acs-text"><p class="kicker">Signum &middot; the card of the album</p><h2 class="section-title ink">VII &middot; Le Chariot</h2><p>Every record in this house is counted the old way. Its name gives a number, and the number opens one of the old cards. This one was drawn for He Goes to the Priest.</p></div></div></div></section>
    <section class="why-section" id="why" aria-labelledby="why-title">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="divider" aria-hidden="true"><span class="divider-line"></span><span class="divider-label">Causa</span><span class="seal seal-black seal-divider lit"></span><span class="divider-label divider-label-r">VI</span><span class="divider-line"></span></div>
        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/he-goes-to-the-priest.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">He Goes to the Priest</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">A play in nine steps, up a mountain's spine,</span><span class="ms-l">and dedicated to the ones who went</span><span class="ms-l">the whole way up, to hear that it was fine:</span><span class="ms-l">to them, the play and all its steps are meant.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">The priest keeps the weight; the box; the next height, too;</span><span class="ms-l">no word of forgiveness does he speak to you.</span><span class="ms-l">Church-sick, no soft healing; the path will only go</span><span class="ms-l">up, and up. It never comes back down below.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>
      </div>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">wax, ash, ink</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">VI</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The climb</p>
            <h3>Nine steps</h3>
            <p>A play in nine steps up a mountain, and a dedication to the ones who climbed to be told it was fine. The priest keeps the weight, the box and the next height; nothing he says is forgiveness.</p>
            <p>The path only goes up, and it does not come back down.</p>
          </article>

      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="divider" aria-hidden="true"><span class="divider-line"></span><span class="divider-label">Causa</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-divider lit"></span><span class="divider-label divider-label-r">IX</span><span class="divider-line"></span></div>
        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/so-may-he-rest.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">So May He Rest</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Fourteen real lullabies, in tongues long dead,</span><span class="ms-l">sung tenderly to a child, and softly said</span><span class="ms-l">to one who will not wake: in Akkadian, in Greek,</span><span class="ms-l">in Coptic, Hittite, Syriac they speak,</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">in Old Norse, and in more. Each word is drawn</span><span class="ms-l">from old incantations, from the charms upon</span><span class="ms-l">a crying child, from what the gravestones keep:</span><span class="ms-l">so tender on the surface, crushing deep.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">A high herding call above them rings</span><span class="ms-l">over a raw women's circle, strong;</span><span class="ms-l">with stones and spades for drums it sings.</span><span class="ms-l">Each word is old, and has been old for long.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">And every cradle is a grave. And so</span><span class="ms-l">the oldest words are sung to him, and low,</span><span class="ms-l">as tenderly as lullabies know best:</span><span class="ms-l">so may he rest. So may he rest.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">kept under glass</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">VIII</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The cradle</p>
            <h3>So may he rest</h3>
            <p>Fourteen real lullabies in dead tongues, sung tenderly for a child who will not wake. Akkadian, Coptic, Hittite, Greek, Syriac, Old Norse and more, taken from old incantations, crying-child charms and grave inscriptions.</p>
            <p>Tender on the surface, crushing underneath. Every word is old. Every cradle is a grave. So may he rest.</p>
          </article>
        </div>

Its name gives a number, and the number opens one of the old cards. This one was drawn for Soft God Is the Lie.</p></div></div></div></section>
    <section class="why-section" id="why" aria-labelledby="why-title">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="divider" aria-hidden="true"><span class="divider-line"></span><span class="divider-label">Causa</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-divider lit"></span><span class="divider-label divider-label-r">III</span><span class="divider-line"></span></div>
        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/soft-god-is-the-lie.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">Soft God Is the Lie</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">They built a soft god for the field.</span><span class="ms-l">He came, but he came bloody, red.</span><span class="ms-l">She stood in front and did not yield.</span><span class="ms-l">The quiet held. Nothing was said.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">The soft god stays the lie, in dirt and iron sealed;</span><span class="ms-l">there's Egypt in the drums, and Rome in bones concealed;</span><span class="ms-l">a dead tongue under a possessing voice is laid.</span><span class="ms-l">No soft healing comes; no remix of the cut is made.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">written after midnight</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">V</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The field</p>
            <h3>Soft god stays the lie</h3>
            <p>They built a soft god for the field. He came bloody. She stood in front. The quiet held.</p>
            <p>Soft god stays the lie — sealed in dirt and iron, Egypt in the drums, Rome in the bones. No soft-heal.</p>
          </article>

    <section class="why-section" id="why" aria-labelledby="why-title">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="divider" aria-hidden="true"><span class="divider-line"></span><span class="divider-label">Causa</span><span class="seal seal-black seal-divider lit"></span><span class="divider-label divider-label-r">IV</span><span class="divider-line"></span></div>
        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/the-angel-over-the-chair.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">The Angel Over the Chair</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><h3 class="ms-title why-letter-title">The Angel</h3><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Two years without the needle.</span><span class="ms-l">Two years of skin gone quiet,</span><span class="ms-l">of roads that rose and fell</span><span class="ms-l">and never told me where they end.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">So I wrote on the back of my own name.</span><span class="ms-l">I turned it over, and the dark came through.</span><span class="ms-l">One sheet. One book. Three notebooks,</span><span class="ms-l">black with what I could not say out loud.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">There is a chair.</span><span class="ms-l">You sit down in it, and you die.</span><span class="ms-l">The needle drinks, the ink bites deep,</span><span class="ms-l">and something stands behind you</span><span class="ms-l">that has watched you bleed before.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">I do not ask for mercy there.</span><span class="ms-l">I ask for the hurt.</span><span class="ms-l">I need it the way the drowned need air.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">And when the black is sealed beneath the skin</span><span class="ms-l">and the ritual is done,</span><span class="ms-l">I open my eyes</span><span class="ms-l">and I am alive again,</span><span class="ms-l">for now.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">The pain is not the point.</span><span class="ms-l">It is the door.</span><span class="ms-l">And I keep coming back to knock.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div></article></div></div></div>
      </div>
    </section>

        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">wax, ash, ink</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">I</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="example-flag">Example diary text</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The chair</p>
            <h3>A placeholder diary</h3>
            <p>This album is live on the public Suno profile under this title. No official album description was published with it, so these lines are only a stand-in.</p>
            <p>The eight songs begin with The Angel Over the Chair and end with What the Black Covers. When a finished diary is written, it can take this place.</p>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">the seal holds</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">IX</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">On Suno</p>
            <h3>The Boxes That Still Play</h3>
            <p>Nine songs from the house where the music boxes never stopped. The first box, the box under water, the book that will not close, and the last box of all. Luna Rose walks through these rooms. The only church left is the one that still plays.</p>
          </article>

        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/the-face-down.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">The Face-Down</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Five songs for those found face down where they lay,</span><span class="ms-l">beneath the ink; the cut that came to stay;</span><span class="ms-l">the dead, borne home and carried all the way:</span><span class="ms-l">these five songs before them now I lay.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Dark, close and ritual, they are sung</span><span class="ms-l">by a porcelain voice, and from its tongue</span><span class="ms-l">not once is any glance turned aside:</span><span class="ms-l">it does not look away from those who died.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>

      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">the seal holds</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">IV</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">Face down</p>
            <h3>The ones found</h3>
            <p>Five songs for the ones found face down. Under the ink, the cut that stayed, and the dead carried home.</p>
            <p>Dark, close and ritual, with a porcelain voice that does not look away.</p>

        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">the seal holds</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">IX</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The road</p>
            <h3>Nobody walks back</h3>
            <p>Five songs for the road nobody walks back. A lake of drinks, an offering table, a throne that is wept over, and the dead left free at last.</p>
            <p>Old ritual voices under a porcelain one. What goes down to the water does not come home.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">written after midnight</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">X</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">On Suno</p>
            <h3>We Are the Field</h3>
            <p>An epic cinematic journey into the ancient battlefield of the Second Punic War (218–146 BC). Blending dark atmospheric neoclassical elements, tragic orchestration, and a haunting atmosphere of doom and heroism.</p>
          </article>

        </figure><div class="acs-text"><p class="kicker">Signum &middot; the card of the album</p><h2 class="section-title ink">IIII &middot; L&#x27;Empereur</h2><p>Every record in this house is counted the old way.     <section class="why-section" id="why" aria-labelledby="why-title">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="divider" aria-hidden="true"><span class="divider-line"></span><span class="divider-label">Causa</span><span class="seal seal-black seal-divider lit"></span><span class="divider-label divider-label-r">X</span><span class="divider-line"></span></div>
        <p class="section-kicker">The creator&rsquo;s note</p>
        <h2 id="why-title" class="section-title ink">Why this album was made</h2>
        <div class="ms ms-twin"><div class="ms-grid"><div class="ms-book"><div class="msb-frame msb-cover"><img src="../images/hall/what-the-fire-kept.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy"></div><p class="msb-cap">What the Fire Kept</p></div><div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter why-letter why-poem"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker">In his own hand</p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">Two nights around a single fire;</span><span class="ms-l">the drums, the stones, the blood; the crowd</span><span class="ms-l">that wants them burned upon the pyre</span><span class="ms-l">and calls for it, and calls aloud.</span></p><p class="ms-st"><span class="ms-l">And two who will not die dance through</span><span class="ms-l">the flames, and on through them they tread,</span><span class="ms-l">then lie down, side by side, the two,</span><span class="ms-l">in the warm ash, as in a bed.</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><p class="ms-sign why-sign">— M.A.</p></article></div></div></div>
      </div>

    <section class="diary-section" id="diary">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="section-kicker">The diary</p>
        <h2 class="section-title ink">The story behind the album</h2>
        <div class="diary grimoire"><span class="marginalia m1" aria-hidden="true">seen by the third candle</span><span class="marginalia m2" aria-hidden="true">II</span><span class="seal seal-red seal-page lit" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <p class="notes-flag">From the album notes</p>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The first night</p>
            <h3>Two nights around one fire</h3>
            <p>Two nights around one fire. Drums, stones, blood and a crowd that wants them burned. Two who will not die dance through the flames and lie down together in the warm ash.</p>
          </article>
          <article class="diary-entry">
            <p class="diary-date">The second night</p>
            <h3>What the fire kept</h3>
            <p>The drums return, then fall silent. Only ash and wind remain. They lie down together in the warm ash and sleep. They do not die.</p>
          </article>
        </div>

        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink">Project archive</h1>
        <p class="intro">Letters, scraps, sealed pages, set-aside covers, the marks that return and the things left behind in the house. Album covers live with the records themselves.</p>

      <p class="room-hint room-hint-static hint-gallery">Six drawers &middot; pull one open</p>
      <article class="pa-warning pw-poem" id="warning" aria-labelledby="warning-title">
        <span class="pw-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <h2 class="pw-title" id="warning-title">A Warning to the Listener</h2>
        <div class="pw-text"><p class="pw-st"><span class="pw-l">I did not write these to be sung for sport.</span><br><span class="pw-l">I wrote them as a rite, for my own soul,</span><br><span class="pw-l">and left the door ajar so you could hear.</span><br><span class="pw-l">I do not play with the dark. I study it.</span><br><span class="pw-l">Nothing here calls what you would not want near.</span><br><span class="pw-l pw-beat">Keep it so.</span></p><span class="pw-orn" aria-hidden="true">&#10022;</span><p class="pw-st"><span class="pw-l">She was not summoned by my hand.</span><br><span class="pw-l">She came on her own, after a rite that was not mine,</span><br><span class="pw-l">a guide, and an evil one.</span><br><span class="pw-l">She will seem sweet. She will seem kind.</span><br><span class="pw-l">She will seem like nothing that could ever harm you.</span><br><span class="pw-l pw-beat">Wait.</span><br><span class="pw-l">Invite her in, speak to her, play,</span><br><span class="pw-l">and she will not leave.</span><br><span class="pw-l">She stays, and the rooms of your life</span><br><span class="pw-l">turn slowly into a living hell.</span></p><span class="pw-orn" aria-hidden="true">&#10022;</span><p class="pw-st"><span class="pw-l">These words are the craft.</span><br><span class="pw-l">Twist them, add to them, speak them where they were never meant to be,</span><br><span class="pw-l">and it can go wrong.</span><br><span class="pw-l">Do not run to God then.</span><br><span class="pw-l">If he did not come before,</span><br><span class="pw-l">why would he come now?</span></p><span class="pw-orn" aria-hidden="true">&#10022;</span><p class="pw-st"><span class="pw-l">If you must sit down at the board,</span><br><span class="pw-l">learn first what it costs when it goes wrong.</span><br><span class="pw-l">Ward yourself. Seek the ones who truly know,</span><br><span class="pw-l">a real witch, a true seer.</span><br><span class="pw-l">Do not walk into the flame</span><br><span class="pw-l">believing you will walk back out.</span></p><span class="pw-orn" aria-hidden="true">&#10022;</span><p class="pw-st"><span class="pw-l">In time, a page will open here:</span><br><span class="pw-l"><a class="pw-wards" href="wards.html">wards, and how they are made.</a></span><br><span class="pw-l pw-beat">Only those.</span><br><span class="pw-l">Nothing that harms will be taught by me.</span></p><span class="pw-orn" aria-hidden="true">&#10022;</span><p class="pw-st"><span class="pw-l">I hold no faith. Believe what you will.</span><br><span class="pw-l">But keep my words out of what you wish to do.</span><br><span class="pw-l pw-last">Cross this line, and you cross it alone.</span></p></div>
        <p class="pw-sig">&mdash; M.A.</p>
        <span class="pw-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      </article><div class="pa-cabinet">
      <details class="pa-drawer" id="letters" data-pa="letters">
        <summary class="pa-front"><span class="pa-num" aria-hidden="true">I</span><span class="pa-plate"><span class="pa-t">Letters from the Ballerina</span><span class="pa-s">every one under wax</span></span><span class="pa-count">12 sealed</span><span class="pa-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="pa-pull" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <div class="pa-in"><p class="pa-lead">Short letters in her hand, every one under wax. Each seal answers to the same number: the one that opened the house. What you break here cannot be pressed shut again.</p><div class="pa-letters"><article class="pa-letter pl-v1 is-locked" data-letter="1" data-lock="9c8547f63ad122b06dad7a68b44af1ba8c7c6ec65d3a1b904e16bf0cf341d47a" data-ink="MkdxnRIJl3desKKyRMBaSHa/3hFwwRYLQW0V+LnK4aCv3MMXMNi1erFcKyk86t0vZCezu3rMmmG0EtTtYDBEB7ktbc35oPzPJqZWtJOdDlryTW5Zk5tqVr91/SwfvJR1Zrp8nkkr901Pzj42WZGcR22490Z5/EOCL8tnV+gOCGoZ+gT8jYmE/oj4Yh9JISpAM3UdlVfORQJRqqpZn7yWgcyGy0ej+E+jpSm6SNSnHeXKt81Zb2DxfRzn/fq4qlcBa14wg9jk0ayFaKDf5aL9gSk/DXg2">
            <div class="pl-env"><span class="pl-stamp">Sealed · for the dead only</span><span class="pl-no">Letter I</span><span class="pl-seal" aria-hidden="true"><i class="pl-half pl-h1"></i><i class="pl-half pl-h2"></i></span>
              <p class="pl-warn">Whoever breaks this wax is read in return.</p>
              <form class="pl-lock" autocomplete="off" hidden><label class="visually-hidden" for="pl-key-1">The number for letter I</label><input id="pl-key-1" class="pl-key" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false" maxlength="24" placeholder="the number"><button type="submit" class="pl-break">Break the seal</button></form>
              <p class="pl-msg" aria-live="polite"></p></div>
            <div class="pl-page" hidden></div>
          </article><article class="pa-letter pl-v2 is-locked" data-letter="2" data-lock="cdbebc692baddecafd3d3dc89492a0637bed418689a06da6f91121d6479ab245" data-ink="c4s5yXBMNGYFcv/40VHrrtlHtRM8fRBd2OEusKq3Fw4ykZw1GX1fAaPbyWAzgvt3/2ZPw1wuIDS46n2cfjzt40hQIi1434S8SndOEtrOCkV6Xusgk1LW2iHZTZnR5O3tmI6fw729nfe1praCVauBBCM+MgyGTbLBLnxtmiiI9RYezcTNJ0fZOorIgtTwlGJYzWKLxsO5pEpfFK4J6+m+XJAcq/7Qya911tWLukw/VXCPvB/a4rb/qedIl41Z4/Llj9zewsBeUhXhxwmXo+E=">

        <div class="pa-in"><p class="pa-lead">Scraps pulled back from the stove: lines from the working pages, in the hand they were sung in. A struck line is only ink; every line here is sung on the record.</p><div class="pa-scraps"><figure class="pa-scrap ps-0"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>

            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Look up. It&#x27;s already gone.</li><li>Kneeling bare by the black of the pond,</li><li class="ps-x">one jar to the water, one jar to the ground.</li><li>Seven small lights and a big one that bleeds,</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track V</span><a href="songs/decima-signata/05-stella.html">Stella</a><span class="ps-alb">Decima Signata</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-2"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Count the floors. Then forget them.</li><li>He built it of thank-yous, brick over brick,</li><li class="ps-x">a stair for each song and a lock for each trick.</li><li>At the top was a crown and a window of glass,</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track VI</span><a href="songs/decima-signata/06-turris.html">Turris</a><span class="ps-alb">Decima Signata</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-3"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Everything fits. That&#x27;s the horror.</li><li>A wreath of black laurel, an oval of thorn,</li><li class="ps-x">I dance in the middle where nothing is born.</li><li>An ox and a lion, an eagle, a man,</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track VII</span><a href="songs/decima-signata/07-mundus.html">Mundus</a><span class="ps-alb">Decima Signata</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-0"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>No number. No floor. No fear.</li><li>A stick on his shoulder, a sack full of nothing,</li><li class="ps-x">he whistles the tune that I taught him for something.</li><li>The dog at his heel has its teeth in his leg,</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track VIII</span><a href="songs/decima-signata/08-stultus.html">Stultus</a><span class="ps-alb">Decima Signata</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-1"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>The box was a grave</li><li>that learned how to open.</li><li class="ps-x">Six feet of velvet, a hinge gone to rust,</li><li>a dancer folded small in a coat of dust.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track IX</span><a href="songs/decima-signata/09-iudicium.html">Iudicium</a><span class="ps-alb">Decima Signata</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-2"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Don&#x27;t break the wax. Break me.</li><li>Nine lie open on the velvet floor,</li><li class="ps-x">the tenth lies face-down by the door.</li><li>I dance around it on broken glass,</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track X</span><a href="songs/decima-signata/10-sigillum.html">Sigillum</a><span class="ps-alb">Decima Signata</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-3"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>A voice at the edge of hearing. No name yet. Only true.</li><li>The mountain does not ask. It states.</li><li class="ps-x">Air thins because height takes it.</li><li>Weight presses because stone is heavier than will.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track I</span><a href="songs/he-goes-to-the-priest/01-the-first-law.html">The First Law</a><span class="ps-alb">He Goes to the Priest</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-0"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>The soft world ends at the first step. The stone does not forgive.</li><li>He puts the first palm on the rock.</li><li class="ps-x">It splits. Red finds the crack and stays.</li><li>No prayer. No name. The climb is the method.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track II</span><a href="songs/he-goes-to-the-priest/02-the-leaving.html">The Leaving</a><span class="ps-alb">He Goes to the Priest</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-1"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Pretty silence. Then the hit that owns the step.</li><li>He climbs on the wrong beat and the stone rejects the hand.</li><li class="ps-x">He waits in the hush — thin, almost kind, a lie.</li><li>The hit comes late and low — a door in the blood.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track III</span><a href="songs/he-goes-to-the-priest/03-where-the-weight-lands.html">Where the Weight Lands</a><span class="ps-alb">He Goes to the Priest</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-2"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Pretty silence. Then the hit that seals the way.</li><li>He turns once. The soft stairs have already forgotten him.</li><li class="ps-x">Stone behind him is wall now — not road.</li><li>What he climbed on will not take the foot down.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track IV</span><a href="songs/he-goes-to-the-priest/04-no-path-down.html">No Path Down</a><span class="ps-alb">He Goes to the Priest</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-3"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Pretty silence. Then the hit that makes the air sharp.</li><li>He still does not understand who has been here the whole time.</li><li class="ps-x">A structure older than kings — gigantic, buried in the dark history he tried to write.</li><li>Power is a game the powerful already play. He brought a box to the board.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track V</span><a href="songs/he-goes-to-the-priest/05-the-ritual-box.html">The Ritual Box</a><span class="ps-alb">He Goes to the Priest</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-0"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Pretty silence. Then the hit that sits in the blood.</li><li>The box is still empty of her.</li><li class="ps-x">What entered him is not empty.</li><li>He tries to spit the dead tongue out. It stays.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track VI</span><a href="songs/he-goes-to-the-priest/06-what-he-keeps.html">What He Keeps</a><span class="ps-alb">He Goes to the Priest</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-1"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Pretty silence. Then the hit that tests the universe in him.</li><li>He brings the weight the box left behind.</li><li class="ps-x">No soft name left to spend. No lid left to raise.</li><li>The next height does not want a threat. It wants respect that does not ask for her name.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track VII</span><a href="songs/he-goes-to-the-priest/07-the-next-height.html">The Next Height</a><span class="ps-alb">He Goes to the Priest</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-2"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Pretty silence. Then the hit that cuts the pew air.</li><li>He brings the unwanted knowledge into a house of soft light.</li><li class="ps-x">He kneels like a man who still believes soft light can undo stone.</li><li>The priest lifts a word meant to clean.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track VIII</span><a href="songs/he-goes-to-the-priest/08-he-goes-to-the-priest.html">He Goes to the Priest</a><span class="ps-alb">He Goes to the Priest</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-3"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Pretty silence. Then the hit that splits the bowl.</li><li>Holy water on the tongue that already speaks dead.</li><li class="ps-x">A medal on the chest that already carries weight.</li><li>Chalk on the floor in a circle that does not know the mountain.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track IX</span><a href="songs/he-goes-to-the-priest/09-blessed-things.html">Blessed Things</a><span class="ps-alb">He Goes to the Priest</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-0"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Soft god is the lie.</li><li>Throat first. Then the palm. Then the dirt that drinks.</li><li class="ps-x">No oil. No book. No soft word over the measure.</li><li>For the soft word —</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track I</span><a href="songs/soft-god-is-the-lie/01-cruor-in-the-dirt.html">Cruor in the Dirt</a><span class="ps-alb">Soft God Is the Lie</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-1"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>You opened what you made.</li><li>I was never outside it.</li><li class="ps-x">Queen of the dead living.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track III</span><a href="songs/the-boxes-that-still-play/03-luna-rose.html">Luna Rose</a><span class="ps-alb">The Boxes That Still Play</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-2"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>The road west smells of oranges and ash.</li><li>I tied your ribbon to my wrist where the sword sits.</li><li class="ps-x">Spain behind me, gold in the evening, and you in the doorway.</li><li>You did not wave. You held the frame like a mast in a storm.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track I</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/01-the-dust-remembers.html">The Dust Remembers</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-3"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>I came down out of the stone with half of us left.</li><li>Your ribbon is grey with dust now. I still know its color in the dark.</li><li class="ps-x">Italy smells of wet earth and someone else&#x27;s harvest.</li><li>We eat what the fields forgot. We eat what the dead grey ones gave.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track II</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/02-what-the-river-holds.html">What the River Holds</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>

            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>White on the water.</li><li>White on the road.</li><li class="ps-x">I lie in the hill with my mouth on the grass.</li><li>They march in the fog.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track III</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/03-when-the-fog-burns-off.html">When the Fog Burns Off</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-1"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Dry plain. White sun.</li><li>The river thin as a vein.</li><li class="ps-x">Wind at my back, full of dust,</li><li>blowing straight into their eyes.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track IV</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/04-the-ring-closes.html">The Ring Closes</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>

            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track V</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/05-no-room-to-fall.html">No Room to Fall</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-3"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>The land goes black behind us.</li><li>Fire in the barley. Fire in the vines.</li><li class="ps-x">Farmhouses open like red flowers in the dark.</li><li>We eat the orchards to the root.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track VI</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/06-the-gates-stay-shut.html">The Gates Stay Shut</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
