            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track VIII</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/08-the-last-feast.html">The Last Feast</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-1"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Two camps of reed asleep on the plain.</li><li>Cold dry night. A thousand huts like haystacks.</li><li class="ps-x">I keep the late watch on the ridge, and the stars are close.</li><li>Then one small light down by the gate.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track IX</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/09-sparks-like-stars.html">Sparks Like Stars</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-2"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>The sea at dawn, folded like linen.</li><li>Fifteen years of Italy at my back.</li><li class="ps-x">The ships wait on the water like birds that forgot how to leave.</li><li>I tie your ribbon on again. It is only a thread now, grey as my hair.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track X</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/10-the-horses-on-the-sand.html">The Horses on the Sand</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-3"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Peace on paper. Ink still wet.</li><li>Then ships break on our shore in a storm,</li><li class="ps-x">full of their bread, and we take it.</li><li>Now they come up the valley, town by town,</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track XI</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/11-the-flies-know-first.html">The Flies Know First</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-0"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Dawn on a plain with no shade.</li><li>Eighty grey mountains walk ahead of us,</li><li class="ps-x">bells on their necks, towers on their backs.</li><li>Then their horns, their trumpets, all at once,</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track XII</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/12-we-are-the-field.html">We Are the Field</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-1"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Quiet now. No horns.</li><li>Only the flies, the sun, and me, looking down.</li><li class="ps-x">The ring is still there, a ring of us, lying where it closed.</li><li>Three days of heat, and we swell like wineskins,</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track XIII</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/13-five-hundred-lanterns.html">Five Hundred Lanterns</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-2"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>I tied it on your wrist the morning you left.</li><li>Red ribbon, bitten through with my teeth.</li><li class="ps-x">Half for you. Half for me.</li><li>You did not look back. I did not ask you to.</li></ol>
            <figcaption><span class="ps-note">track XIV</span><a href="songs/we-are-the-field/14-burn-little-lamp.html">Burn, Little Lamp</a><span class="ps-alb">We Are the Field</span></figcaption>
          </figure><figure class="pa-scrap ps-3"><span class="ps-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <ol class="ps-lines"><li>Fifty-five years. The lamp is still lit.</li><li>Now the ships in the bay are theirs, and they do not leave.</li><li class="ps-x">Three years of siege. Bread of bark and boiled leather.</li><li>The children&#x27;s ribs like the ribs of little boats.</li></ol>

      <details class="pa-drawer" id="symbols" data-pa="symbols">
        <summary class="pa-front"><span class="pa-num" aria-hidden="true">V</span><span class="pa-plate"><span class="pa-t">Register of symbols</span><span class="pa-s">sigils, cards and numbers that return</span></span><span class="pa-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="pa-pull" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <div class="pa-in"><p class="pa-lead">Every mark this house uses, and only those. Each one is somewhere on these pages, keeping watch. Learn them before they learn you.</p><h3 class="pa-h">Sigils</h3><ul class="sy-sigils"><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><img src="images/letter/sigil-7.svg" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></span><div><h4>The sigil of seven</h4><p class="sy-where">under the dancer, in the corners of the letters, on the press page</p><p class="sy-poem">His mark: seven points, and a second star of seven turning inside the first.<br>It burns in the floor beneath the dancer and stands in the corners of every letter.<br>Where it is drawn, the house is listening.</p></div></li><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><picture class="phone-picture"><source media="(max-width:900px),(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse)" srcset="images/doors/ouro-sigil-phone.webp"><img src="images/doors/ouro-sigil.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></picture></span><div><h4>The wheel of the first door</h4><p class="sy-where">the first of the three doors</p><p class="sy-poem">A star of seven caught in a ring of marks that are never read aloud.<br>It turns on the first door. Every record waits behind it, in the order it was buried.</p></div></li><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><picture class="phone-picture"><source media="(max-width:900px),(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse)" srcset="images/doors/eye-sigil-phone.webp"><img src="images/doors/eye-sigil.jpg?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></picture></span><div><h4>The eye above the hourglass</h4><p class="sy-where">the second of the three doors</p><p class="sy-poem">A winged eye that cannot close, over sand that cannot stop.<br>It keeps the archive. It is not counting the hours. It is counting who comes in.</p></div></li><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><img src="images/archive/emblem-v4-640.webp?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></span><div><h4>Skull, scythe and sword</h4><p class="sy-where">the third door, and under every drawer</p><p class="sy-poem">Death kept in good order: the skull to remember, the scythe to gather, the sword to hold the gate.<br>It stands under every drawer, and over the door of the one with no face.</p></div></li><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><img src="images/death/ouroboros.webp?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></span><div><h4>The serpent and the hourglass</h4><p class="sy-where">between the chambers of every page</p><p class="sy-poem">A serpent swallowing its own tail around the falling sand.<br>It divides one chamber from the next: what ends here has already begun again.</p></div></li><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><picture class="phone-picture"><source media="(max-width:900px),(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse)" srcset="images/ritual/seal-blood-phone.webp"><img src="images/ritual/seal-blood.webp?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></picture></span><div><h4>The bleeding seal</h4><p class="sy-where">on the threshold</p><p class="sy-poem">A skull between two blades, pressed in wax that never quite dried.<br>It is the first thing every visitor meets, and it breaks only for the number of perfection.</p></div></li><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><picture class="phone-picture"><source media="(max-width:900px),(hover:none) and (pointer:coarse)" srcset="images/letter/seal-ma-phone.webp"><img src="images/letter/seal-ma.webp?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></picture></span><div><h4>The M.A. seal</h4><p class="sy-where">on the letters and the greetings</p><p class="sy-poem">The mark of Morrow Ash in red wax.<br>Whole, it keeps a page shut. Broken, it means someone has read what was not theirs to read.</p></div></li><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><img src="images/ritual/seal-red.webp?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></span><div><h4>The seven-point seal</h4><p class="sy-where">on the sealed pages, in red and in black</p><p class="sy-poem">Seven points sunk into wax: red for what is sealed, black for what stays sealed.<br>It marks the pages the house does not give back.</p></div></li><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><img src="images/fx/footer-sigil.webp?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></span><div><h4>The thorned sun</h4><p class="sy-where">at the foot of every page</p><p class="sy-poem">A sun that wears its thorns on the inside.<br>It burns at the foot of every page, so no one leaves without passing under it.</p></div></li><li class="sy-item"><span class="sy-img"><img src="images/fx/moon-v34.webp?v=1795461498" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"></span><div><h4>The red moon</h4><p class="sy-where">over the house, in its true phase</p><p class="sy-poem">The moon the graveyard keeps, shown in its true phase.<br>It is always a little too red to be only light.</p></div></li></ul><h3 class="pa-h">Cards that return</h3><ul class="sy-cards"><li class="sy-card"><img src="images/tarot/m18.jpg?v=1795461498" width="480" height="854" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"><h4>XVIII · The Moon</h4><p class="sy-en">drawn for 12 songs</p><p>Illusion, fear, anxiety, the subconscious, intuition</p></li><li class="sy-card"><img src="images/tarot/m09.jpg?v=1795461498" width="480" height="854" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"><h4>VIIII · The Hermit</h4><p class="sy-en">drawn for 10 songs</p><p>Introspection, solitude, inner guidance, searching</p></li><li class="sy-card"><img src="images/tarot/m14.jpg?v=1795461498" width="480" height="854" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"><h4>XIIII · Temperance</h4><p class="sy-en">drawn for 9 songs</p><p>Balance, moderation, patience, purpose</p></li><li class="sy-card"><img src="images/tarot/m02.jpg?v=1795461498" width="480" height="854" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"><h4>II · The Popess</h4><p class="sy-en">drawn for 8 songs</p><p>Intuition, mystery, the subconscious, hidden knowledge</p></li><li class="sy-card"><img src="images/tarot/m17.jpg?v=1795461498" width="480" height="854" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"><h4>XVII · The Star</h4><p class="sy-en">drawn for 8 songs</p><p>Hope, renewal, inspiration, serenity</p></li><li class="sy-card"><img src="images/tarot/m16.jpg?v=1795461498" width="480" height="854" alt="" loading="lazy" draggable="false"><h4>XVI · The Tower</h4><p class="sy-en">drawn for 8 songs</p><p>Sudden upheaval, revelation, chaos, awakening</p></li></ul><h3 class="pa-h">Numbers that return</h3><ul class="sy-nums"><li class="sy-num"><span class="sn-n">8</span><h4>Iron in the Hand</h4><p class="sy-en">the number of 21 songs</p><p>You were given weight, and the shoulders to carry it.</p></li><li class="sy-num"><span class="sn-n">5</span><h4>The Open Door</h4><p class="sy-en">the number of 19 songs</p><p>No room keeps you long.</p></li><li class="sy-num"><span class="sn-n">7</span><h4>The Desk at Night</h4><p class="sy-en">the number of 17 songs</p><p>You are the one still awake when the house sleeps.</p></li><li class="sy-num"><span class="sn-n">4</span><h4>Stone and Beam</h4><p class="sy-en">the number of 15 songs</p><p>You are the beam that holds the roof.</p></li><li class="sy-num"><span class="sn-n">6</span><h4>The Hand at the Back</h4><p class="sy-en">the number of 13 songs</p><p>You hold others the way a dancer holds a partner:</p></li><li class="sy-num"><span class="sn-n">11</span><h4>The Lit Window</h4><p class="sy-en">the number of 13 songs</p><p>You see by a light others cannot find.</p></li></ul><p class="pa-more"><a href="numbers.html">Count your own name</a> &middot; <a href="tarot.html">Draw the cards</a></p></div>

        <p class="kicker">A greeting from the ghost</p>
        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink" id="gr-title">Someone sent you a greeting</h1>
        <div class="mirror-stage greeting-stage is-gazing is-clear is-spoken" data-greeting data-others="dancer-candle-forgot-stop leave-door-open-only turn-dark-dark-has slippers-wore-through-floor light-candle-will-lend was-porcelain-crack-where every-mirror-this-house dance-where-dust-settles do-not-be-afraid your-name-pressed-into music-box-stopped-did breathe-on-glass-will keep-hour-no-clock hold-still-learning-shape moon-red-tonight-because bow-empty-chairs-they under-floorboards-rehearsal-never ash-on-shoulders-rust when-candle-gutters-curtsying you-came-this-far hush-between-two-notes seal-broken-come-mind lost-music-learned-dance">

              <p class="mr-sign">&mdash; the Ballerina</p>

        <p class="kicker">A greeting from the ghost</p>
        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink" id="gr-title">Someone sent you a greeting</h1>
        <div class="mirror-stage greeting-stage is-gazing is-clear is-spoken" data-greeting data-others="dancer-candle-forgot-stop leave-door-open-only turn-dark-dark-has slippers-wore-through-floor light-candle-will-lend was-porcelain-crack-where every-mirror-this-house do-not-be-afraid your-name-pressed-into music-box-stopped-did breathe-on-glass-will keep-hour-no-clock hold-still-learning-shape moon-red-tonight-because bow-empty-chairs-they under-floorboards-rehearsal-never close-your-eyes-already ash-on-shoulders-rust when-candle-gutters-curtsying you-came-this-far hush-between-two-notes seal-broken-come-mind lost-music-learned-dance">
          <i class="mr-candle mr-cl" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="mr-candle mr-cr" aria-hidden="true"></i>

              <p class="mr-open">Porcelain Ballerina says</p>
              <blockquote class="mr-line gr-line"><p>&ldquo;I dance where the dust settles, and the dust stays to watch.&rdquo;</p></blockquote>
              <p class="mr-sign">&mdash; the Ballerina</p>

        <div class="mirror-stage greeting-stage is-gazing is-clear is-spoken" data-greeting data-others="dancer-candle-forgot-stop leave-door-open-only turn-dark-dark-has slippers-wore-through-floor light-candle-will-lend was-porcelain-crack-where every-mirror-this-house dance-where-dust-settles do-not-be-afraid your-name-pressed-into music-box-stopped-did breathe-on-glass-will keep-hour-no-clock hold-still-learning-shape moon-red-tonight-because bow-empty-chairs-they under-floorboards-rehearsal-never close-your-eyes-already ash-on-shoulders-rust when-candle-gutters-curtsying you-came-this-far seal-broken-come-mind lost-music-learned-dance">

        <p class="kicker">A greeting from the ghost</p>
        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink" id="gr-title">Someone sent you a greeting</h1>
        <div class="mirror-stage greeting-stage is-gazing is-clear is-spoken" data-greeting data-others="dancer-candle-forgot-stop turn-dark-dark-has slippers-wore-through-floor light-candle-will-lend was-porcelain-crack-where every-mirror-this-house dance-where-dust-settles do-not-be-afraid your-name-pressed-into music-box-stopped-did breathe-on-glass-will keep-hour-no-clock hold-still-learning-shape moon-red-tonight-because bow-empty-chairs-they under-floorboards-rehearsal-never close-your-eyes-already ash-on-shoulders-rust when-candle-gutters-curtsying you-came-this-far hush-between-two-notes seal-broken-come-mind lost-music-learned-dance">
          <i class="mr-candle mr-cl" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="mr-candle mr-cr" aria-hidden="true"></i>
          <div class="mr-glass">
            <div class="mr-depth" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="mr-ghost" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="mr-smoke" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i></div>
            <div class="mr-tarnish" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="mr-breath" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="mr-greeting">
              <p class="mr-open">Porcelain Ballerina says</p>
              <blockquote class="mr-line gr-line"><p>&ldquo;Leave the door open. I only knock with cold.&rdquo;</p></blockquote>
              <p class="mr-sign">&mdash; the Ballerina</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="mr-frame" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          <img class="mr-seal" src="../images/letter/seal-ma-sm.webp?v=1795461498" srcset="../images/letter/seal-ma-sm.webp?v=33 360w, ../images/letter/seal-ma.webp?v=33 796w" sizes="(max-width:699px) 90px, 110px" width="120" height="136" alt="" aria-hidden="true" draggable="false">
        </div>
        <p class="gr-invite">She dances for whoever opens the door. The house is open.</p>

        <p class="kicker">A greeting from the ghost</p>
        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink" id="gr-title">Someone sent you a greeting</h1>
        <div class="mirror-stage greeting-stage is-gazing is-clear is-spoken" data-greeting data-others="dancer-candle-forgot-stop leave-door-open-only turn-dark-dark-has slippers-wore-through-floor light-candle-will-lend every-mirror-this-house dance-where-dust-settles do-not-be-afraid your-name-pressed-into music-box-stopped-did breathe-on-glass-will keep-hour-no-clock hold-still-learning-shape moon-red-tonight-because bow-empty-chairs-they under-floorboards-rehearsal-never close-your-eyes-already ash-on-shoulders-rust when-candle-gutters-curtsying you-came-this-far hush-between-two-notes seal-broken-come-mind lost-music-learned-dance">

        <p class="kicker">Diarium &middot; in his own hand</p>
        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink">The Journal</h1>
      </div>

    <section class="journal" aria-label="Journal entries">
      <div class="wrap"><div class="jr-ledger"><span class="jr-spine" aria-hidden="true"></span><article class="jr-entry"><span class="jr-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="jr-date"><time datetime="2026-11-17">17 November 2026</time></p><h2 class="jr-title">Letter to the Voice</h2><div class="jr-body"><p>You taught me numbers that mean doors, and words no one alive still speaks. I hid them in the songs, where you told me to.</p><p>Not all of it. Some of it is only a man asking for one dance.</p></div><span class="jr-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="jr-sign">&mdash; M.A.</p></article><article class="jr-entry"><span class="jr-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="jr-date"><time datetime="2026-11-16">16 November 2026</time></p><h2 class="jr-title">Glass</h2><div class="jr-body"><p>There is breath on the window this morning. Not mine. Someone wrote a rhyme in it, backwards, from the other side.</p><p>By noon it was gone, and I was one day older. She was not.</p></div><span class="jr-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="jr-sign">&mdash; M.A.</p></article><article class="jr-entry"><span class="jr-burn" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="jr-date"><time datetime="2026-11-15">15 November 2026</time></p><h2 class="jr-title">Ink</h2><div class="jr-body"><p>She has never told me her name. I have stopped asking.</p><p>Some nights the page answers before I&#x27;ve finished the line, and I write down what she says as if it were mine.</p></div><span class="jr-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="jr-sign">&mdash; M.A.</p></article></div></div>
    </section>

        <aside class="mirror-greetings"><p class="kicker">A greeting from the ghost</p><h2>Send a little haunting</h2><p>A few words from the Ballerina. Open one, then share its link with someone.</p><a class="btn btn-solid" href="greeting/dancer-candle-forgot-stop.html" data-open-greeting>Find a greeting</a></aside>
      </div>
    </section>

    <header class="page-head page-head-tight">
      <div class="wrap">
        <p class="kicker">The room of numbers</p>
        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink">Numbers</h1>
        <p class="lead">Give the room your birth date, your full birth name, or both. It counts them the old way and reads back what it finds.</p>
      </div>
    </header>
    <section class="num-room" data-numbers>
      <div class="wrap">
        <form class="num-form" novalidate>
          <div class="num-field"><label for="num-date">Birth date</label><input id="num-date" name="date" type="date" min="1900-01-01" max="2100-12-31"></div>
          <div class="num-field"><label for="num-name">Full birth name</label><input id="num-name" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Every first, middle and last name"></div>
          <p class="num-private">Nothing you type leaves this page or is kept.</p>
          <p class="num-act"><button type="submit" class="btn btn-solid">Count</button> <button type="reset" class="btn">Clear</button></p>
          <p class="num-err" role="alert" hidden></p>
        </form>
        <div class="num-results" aria-live="polite"></div>
        <details class="num-method">
          <summary>How the numbers are counted</summary>
          <p><b>Life path.</b> Write the birth date as day, month and year. Reduce each of the three separately by adding its digits until one digit is left. Then add the three results and reduce the total the same way. If 11, 22 or 33 appears at any step, keep it and stop. Note: some practitioners instead add every digit of the date at once, which can give a different result.</p>
          <p><b>Expression.</b> Write the full birth name, every first, middle and last name. Give each letter its value from the table (A=1 … I=9, then J=1 again). Add all the values and reduce the total the same way, keeping 11, 22 or 33. Letters are valued A, J, S = 1; B, K, T = 2; C, L, U = 3; D, M, V = 4; E, N, W = 5; F, O, X = 6; G, P, Y = 7; H, Q, Z = 8; I, R = 9.</p>
          <p><b>Reducing.</b> Add the digits of a number together, and repeat until a single digit from 1 to 9 remains. Example: 38 → 3+8 = 11 (a master number, kept); 47 → 4+7 = 11 (kept); 59 → 5+9 = 14 → 1+4 = 5.</p>
          <p><b>Master numbers.</b> 11, 22 and 33 are master numbers. When one of them appears at any step of the reduction, keep it as it is and do not reduce it further.</p>
        </details>

        <h1 class="title-fraktur ink">Press</h1>

    <section class="press" aria-label="Press kit">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="pr-top">
          <div class="pr-logo"><span class="pr-sigil" aria-hidden="true"></span><img class="pr-seal" src="images/letter/seal-ma-sm.webp?v=1795461498" srcset="images/letter/seal-ma-sm.webp?v=33 360w, images/letter/seal-ma.webp?v=33 796w" sizes="90px" width="120" height="136" alt="Wax seal marked M.A."></div>
          <div class="pr-bio">
            <h2 class="pr-h">Short bio</h2>
            <p>Porcelain Ballerina is a dark ritual doom project: records written as rites, a porcelain dancer under scratched glass, candles burning low, and ink that will not dry.</p><p>Every record is a rite, and every rite leaves its mark in ash, wax and ink. The songs are sung in English and in the tongues of the dead.</p><p>Behind it stands Morrow Ash, who works without a face and without a name worth keeping. He writes because the ink would not be still. No face. No name. Only the work.</p>
            <div class="pr-contact">
              <p class="pr-contact-k">Press contact</p>

              <p class="pr-contact-n">Interviews, reviews, features and cover requests. Answered by hand, in time.</p>
